name: Yamedomo Renbo wa Renbo Taru
original_name: 病めども恋慕は恋慕足る
source:
You suddenly, really suddenly, realised last night that you were in love with him.

But he and you are just friends(?). Wouldn't confessing to him make things awkward between them? Wouldn't he pretend it never happened? You think like that. And you find that very sad.... So you decided to mess everything up.

That's right, you decided to become a Yandere overnight! 

[From [url=https://p6ik.itch.io/yamedomo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
昨晚你突然，真的突然，意识到你爱上了他。

但他和你只是朋友（？）。向他表白，他们之间的关系岂不是会变得尴尬？他不会假装这件事没有发生过吗？你是这么想的。你发现这非常悲伤……所以你决定把一切搞砸。

没错，你决定一夜之间成为Yandere！
